title: Offline-first sessions
changes: Removed Firebase: sessions are encrypted locally only (clipboard token or .session file).
Gzip + AES-GCM pack format (sc:v2:) with automatic file export when the clipboard token would be too large.
Restores HttpOnly and host cookies via chrome.cookies.set in the service worker.
Login-focused filters trim analytics/cache keys from storage and noisy cookies (optional stricter cookie mode).
New popup UI and import/export for encrypted session files.
